english.title: Contravene a provision / condition for improvement line for widening street
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[erected a new building, namely **(..SPECIFY BUILDING..), nearer to the centre line of the street than the improvement line prescribed under section 73(1)]_
(B)_[made a permanent excavation below the level of the street nearer to the centre line of the street than the improvement line prescribed under section 73(1)]_
(C)_[contravened a condition, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), imposed in connection with the giving of a consent under section 73(2)]_

of the Highways Act 1980
english.legislation: Contrary to section 73(6) of the Highways Act 1980.

english.notes: Section 312 - proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level 1 on the standard scale and if the offence is continued after conviction he is guilty of a further offence and to a further fine of £2 for each day on which the offence continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
